rules: The head from the skull's planes: a straight nasal line, a flat forehead, a big round cheek plate, the throatlatch notch; head 0.34-0.40 of the withers height.
The eye is one of the largest of any land mammal: a radius of at least 1.6% of the height, set high, about 0.4 of the head's length back from the poll.
Mane and tail are masses of hair that fall with gravity in clumps, never separate ribbons.
